# Commands

This repo is a Frappe app. Most commands run from a **frappe-bench** that has ERPNext installed and this app added with `bench get-app`.

## Install
```sh
bench get-app https://github.com/Tacten/biograph
bench --site <site> install-app healthcare
```

## Tests (server)
```sh
bench --site test_site run-parallel-tests --app healthcare   # what CI runs
bench --site <site> run-tests --app healthcare              # all
bench --site <site> run-tests --doctype "Patient Appointment"  # single doctype
```
The site needs `allow_tests` enabled. See `.github/helper/site_config.json`.

## Lint and format
```sh
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install
npm install            # or yarn; provides eslint
pre-commit run --all-files
```
pre-commit runs ruff (`--fix`), ruff-format, prettier (JS/Vue/CSS, but not `patient_portal/`), eslint, pip-audit, detect-secrets and the basic hygiene hooks.

## Semgrep (Frappe rules)
```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/frappe/semgrep-rules.git .frappe-semgrep-rules
pip install semgrep
semgrep ci --config ./.frappe-semgrep-rules/rules --config r/python.lang.correctness
```

## Patient Portal (Vue SPA)
```sh
yarn install          # root postinstall also installs patient_portal
yarn build            # root: cd patient_portal && yarn build
cd patient_portal && yarn dev   # Vite dev server, proxied to Frappe
```

## Desk assets
```sh
bench build --app healthcare
```

## Migrations
```sh
bench --site <site> migrate   # runs patches.txt and syncs DocType JSON
```
